voice.name: Open Sector - Xenomorph Drone
voice.note: Shares the Xenomorph Drone voice (voices/xenodrone.json): the account holds more than 20 custom voices, all in use, so no new one is designed. Heavier and slower than the plain drone, under the weight of the cannon.
voice.description: A thin, flat, hollow chorus of many young androgynous voices speaking the same words in perfect unison, like a single drone of an alien cyborg hive: lighter and younger than a commander, emotionless and obedient, airy and slightly metallic with a faint electronic buzz and a hollow tube-like resonance, quick clipped machine cadence, no personality of its own.

fire.prompt: A heavy alien plasma cannon firing a single big shot: a rising electric charge whine for half a second, then a deep powerful whumping discharge with a crackling energy thump and a sizzling hiss trailing off, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Steady heavy walking footsteps of a big armoured cyborg carrying a heavy metal cannon, left right left right, six heavy thudding footfalls on dirt with a metallic clank and rattle of the carried gun on each step and a faint servo whir, spread evenly over two seconds, close, no music, no voice
